$source: English copy from design/handoff (Claude Design export, 2026-11-21).
app.name: AstroZ
nav.label: Main
offline.title: Offline — everything still works
offline.body: The panchangam is calculated on this phone. The city list is on the phone too.
privacy.line: Your details stay on this phone. No login, nothing uploaded.
today.title: Today's panchangam
wishes.title: Your wishes
wishes.intro: Pick a wish. We'll read the charts and give you simple, free to-dos.
family.title: Family
family.privacy: Family details stay on this phone. We never send them anywhere.
settings.title: Settings
settings.intro: Language, city, text size and your data.
disclaimer.body: AstroZ offers suggestions based on traditional jyotisham; it does not promise outcomes. Make big decisions together with your family elders. For health, money or legal matters, ask a qualified professional.
today.throughDaySub: From this sunrise to tomorrow's sunrise
family.intro: People saved on this phone. Tap anyone to edit their details.
form.intro: A name is enough to start. Birth date, time and place make every reading more precise.
form.name: Name
form.nameError: Add a name — we use it for peru balam.
form.timeUnknownNote: No problem. Rasi and nakshatram stay close; lagna and dasha will be marked "approximate".
form.privacy: These details stay on this phone.
reveal.title: Your chart is ready
reveal.namaSub: From “{aksharam}”, the first sound of the name
reveal.note: Marriage matching uses the birth star; name strength uses the nama nakshatram.
reveal.calcSub: Looking at {city}'s sunrise and that day's stars. No internet needed.
today.chandraText: The moon is in house {house} from your rasi.
today.taraText: Today's star is number {count} from yours ({tara} tara).
today.rahuText: {time} — don't start new work in this window.
settings.exportSub: Everyone's details saved as one file on this phone
settings.deleteSub: All people and saved dates on this phone will be removed. This can't be undone — export first.
match.title: Marriage matching
match.timeNote: Birth time not known? That's fine — the result will say “approximate”.
match.namesBanner: This is an approximate result from names
match.peru.good: The first sounds of {a} and {b} fall on friendly stars.
match.peru.mixed: {a} and {b}'s name stars are half favourable. Not a big concern.
match.peru.avoid: {a} and {b}: the name stars match less well. Elders often look at the full charts instead.
note.vashya.good: A natural pull towards each other
note.yoni.mixed: Comfortable with a little give and take
note.grahaMaitri.avoid: Little friendship between the rasi lords
note.nadi.avoid: Same nadi — look at it together with elders
match.doshasIntro: These are common in many charts. None of them decides on its own.
dosha.rajju.title: Rajju
dosha.rajju.absent: {a} and {b} are in different rajju groups. Nothing to do here.
dosha.rajju.present: {a} and {b} are in the same rajju group. Many families look at this together with an astrologer.
dosha.vedha.title: Vedha
dosha.vedha.absent: Your stars are not a vedha pair.
dosha.vedha.present: {a} and {b} form a vedha pair. This is worth discussing with an astrologer.
dosha.kuja.title: Kuja dosha
dosha.kuja.absent: Kuja is not in a dosha position in either chart.
dosha.kuja.present: In {name}'s chart, Kuja is in house {house}. This is common in many charts — look at it together with elders.
dosha.kuja.balanced: Both charts have Kuja in a dosha position, which is traditionally treated as balanced. Worth a look with elders.
dosha.kuja.notChecked: Kuja dosha can't be checked without birth charts. Add birth details for an exact answer.
match.shareNote: The card shows names, score and verdict only. No birth details.
why.method: Ashtakoota method, as in the Telugu panchangam tradition.
why.title: {koota} · {points}/{max}
why.body.bhakoot: Bhakoot looks at the distance between the two Moon signs.
todo.eldersBlessings.text: Take blessings from elders in both families
todo.muhurthamTarabalam.text: Pick a muhurtham with tarabalam for both
todo.diyaEngagement.text: Light a diya on the morning of the engagement
todo.diyaTuesday.text: Light a diya together on Tuesday evening
todo.eldersReview.text: Look at both charts together with family elders
todo.muhurthamStrong.text: Choose a muhurtham with strong tarabalam for both
todo.askBirthDetails.text: Ask elders for both people's birth details
todo.fridayBlessings.text: Take elders' blessings on Friday morning
todo.matchAgain.text: Check the match again once you have the charts
wish.jobSub: Best windows in the next 90 days
match.dayRange: {name}'s birth time isn't known and the Moon changed nakshatram or rasi that day, so these points may differ. Add the birth time for an exact match.
match.peruAmbiguous: A name fits more than one nakshatram; the first one was used. Try the names-only match to choose.
mh.title: Muhurtham
mh.whereNote: Sunrise is worked out for this town.
mh.resultsSub: Ranked by score. {count} dates found in {days} days.
mh.noPeople: No one picked: dates are scored without tarabalam and chandrabalam.
mh.none.title: No good muhurtham for {event} in these dates
mh.none.mh.x.tarabalam: Tarabalam is low on these days, that's all. No worry — a good day is close by.
mh.none.generic: These days don't meet the traditional rules for {event}. A good day is close by.
mh.nearestAfter: {n} days after the dates you picked
mh.nearestAfterWeek: {n} days after the week you picked
mhx.mh.x.combust: {planet} is too close to the Sun (moudhyami)
mhx.mh.x.period: Only Rahu kalam, Yamagandam, Gulika, Varjyam or Durmuhurtham left
mhr.clear: A time free of Rahu kalam and durmuhurtham
mhd.shuddhiSub: The five angas and lagna, one by one
mhd.tithi.good: A good tithi for {event}; not a rikta tithi
mhd.nakshatra.neutral: Acceptable; not on the list for {event}
mhd.karana.before: {karana} until {time}; the muhurtham starts after it
mhd.lagna.info: Rising at the start. Lagna is shown, not scored yet.
mhd.sendNote: Only the date and time are sent — no birth details.
mhd.missing: Search again to see this date's details.
mhd.method: Panchanga shuddhi and tarabalam/chandrabalam as in the Telugu panchangam tradition; Rahu kalam, Yamagandam, Gulika, Varjyam and Durmuhurtham are left out of every window.
ics.description: From AstroZ. Check with your family purohit.
nh.title: Gruhapravesam
nh.door: Which way does the main door face?
nh.bestSub: Days with {group} tithis, for the {door} door
nh.bestSubNone: No tithi rule for the {door} door yet — dates are ranked without it.
nh.enterText: {tithi} is a {group} tithi — good for the {door} door. Right foot first, kalasham in hand.
nh.enterNoRule: Sources differ on which tithis suit the {door} door. Ask your family purohit.
nh.rikta: Rikta tithis (Chavithi, Navami, Chaturdashi) suit no direction — none are in this list.
checklist.diya.text: Clean the doorstep and light a diya the evening before
checklist.thoranam.text: Tie a mango-leaf thoranam over the main door
checklist.kalasham.text: Walk in holding a kalasham with water and mango leaves
checklist.elders.text: Invite elders in first and take their blessings
mhx.mh.x.door: Tithi not in the {door} door's group
